Given I am logged into coaches portal, When I select user, Then I should see the SDOH forms assigned to the user partner if configured.
Given I have fetched SDOH forms, Then I should see only those forms assigned to the user partner and validate form details
Given there are no forms configured for the user partner, Then I should not see any forms assigned to the user selected
Given SDOH form configured for the user partner, Then I should be able to trigger SDOH form to the user selected
Given the list of forms configured from FORM BUILDER, Then I should be able to fetch forms like Persona,GLP forms
Given HabiPersona form configured, When I hit FormBuilder List, Then I should be able to trigger HabiPersona form to the user selected
Given GLP-Survey form configured, When I hit FormBuilder List, Then I should be able to trigger GLP-Survey form to the user selected

Given HabiPersona form triggered, When user Login to user portal, Then user should be able to see HabiPersona form in the first order and unless its submitted, other forms should not be visible and can't interact with the app
Given User is interacting with HabiPersona form, When user select different options say OPTION1, Then I should see the form behaviour changing as per the form conditions set
Given User is interacting with HabiPersona form, When user select different options say OPTION2, Then I should see the form behaviour changing as per the form conditions set
Given User is interacting with HabiPersona form, When user select relevant options and reach submit page, Then user should be able to submit HabiPersona form.
Given User is interacting with GLP-survey form, When user select relevant options and reach submit page, Then user should be able to submit GLP-survey form.
Given SDOH form triggered, When user Login to user portal, Then user should be able to see SDOH form with the least order and unless its submitted/skipped, user can't interact with the app
Given User is interacting with SDOH form, When user select relevant options and reach submit page, Then user should be able to submit SDOH form.
Given User has submitted SDOH form, When coach checks this user on coaches portal, Then Coach should be able to see user submitted SDOH form response under User profile-SDOH section
Validate admin is able to delete the form builder assigned to user
Given user's cohort programDate is updated, When there are 7 days left in the program, Then the paywall banner should be validated successfully

Given user's cohort programDate is updated, When there are 1 days left in the program, Then the paywall banner should be validated successfully
Given user's cohort programDate is updated, When there are 0 days left in the program, Then the paywall banner should be validated successfully
Given a user's program has no plans assigned, When the programEnd_date is breached (days_until_payment_due=-1), Then the user should still have access to all features
Given a user's program has plans assigned, When the programEnd_date is breached (days_until_payment_due=-1), Then the user should be blocked from accessing features
Given subscription plans are created from the coach portal, When the user fetches the subscription plans list, Then the correct subscription plans should be displayed
Given a user has no active subscription, When the subscription list is fetched, Then the subscription list should be empty

Given a user has a valid subscription plan, When the user initiates a subscription, Then the subscription should start successfully and navigated back to the app to see subscription successful popup page
Given a user has subscribed to the plan, When the user tries to access the application, Then the user should not be blocked and should have full access
